[EN] The Mystery Deepens
[ES] El misterio se profundiza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I have faith in your abilities
[ES] Tengo fe en tus habilidades
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Samael...you'll pay for this.
[ES] Samael... me las pagarás.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "What kind of mission are we talking about?"
[ES] ¿De qué clase de misión estamos hablando?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You look at Jesper in the eyes.
[ES] Miras a Jesper a los ojos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Jesper again.
[ES] Habla con Jesper de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Count on me."
[ES] Cuenta conmigo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Jesper.
[ES] Informa a Jesper.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Teleportal
[ES] Teleportal
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You found the teleportal!
[ES] ¡Encontraste el teleportal!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the {@linkcreature:220#1501$$teleportal} in the Halls of Utterdark in the Tenebrous Mines.
[ES] Encuentra a {@linkcreature:220#1501$$teleportal} en los Salones de la Oscuridad Total en las Minas Tenebrosas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the Black Hood.
[ES] Encuentra a la Capucha Negra.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The Black Hood! He's the head of the organization. He must be killed!
[ES] ¡La Capucha Negra! Es el líder de la organización. ¡Hay que matarlo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the {@linkcreature:220#1501$$teleportal} to reach the hidden tunnel. Then find the Black Hood.
[ES] Usa a {@linkcreature:220#1501$$teleportal} para llegar al túnel oculto. Luego encuentra a la Capucha Negra.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Attack the Black Hood, then speak to Elleon.
[ES] Ataca a la Capucha Negra y luego habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Bruke in Chebika. [Press to open your inventory and use the Chebika Teleport Scroll.]
[ES] Informa a Bruke en Chebika. [Presiona para abrir tu inventario y usar el Pergamino de teletransporte a Chebika.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Samael in Velika.
[ES] Informa a Samael en Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Outside Headquarters
[ES] Afuera del cuartel general
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report your conversation with Samael to Elleon.
[ES] Informa a Elleon sobre tu conversación con Samael.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go outside Headquarters.
[ES] Sal del cuartel general.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Elleon around Collegium Arcane.
[ES] Busca a Elleon por Collegium Arcane.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find and kill Scions of Lok.
[ES] Busca y mata a los Vastagos de Lok.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
